# - ollama: only container that uses GPU; runs the model. /api/tags, /api/show, and

# - mcp: CPU only. Two processes in one container (two ports): 8000 = MCP protocol (Emacs),
#   8001 = FastAPI agent (control UI, tool-injecting chat, health, vision). Nginx exposes
#   both under /mcp: /mcp → 8000, /mcp/* → 8001. Chat is forwarded to ollama.
# - nginx: /mcp and /mcp/* → mcp container; / and /api/* → ollama.
# Parallel: set OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL to 2+ if your GPU has room; 1 is safest for small VRAM.

  mcp-server:
    build:
      context: ./mcp-server
      dockerfile: Dockerfile

    restart: unless-stopped

      - OLLAMA_NUM_CTX=1024
      - MCP_HTTP_HOST=0.0.0.0
      # - MCP_AGENT_DEBUG=1
      - MCP_HTTP_PORT=8002
      # One request at a time to Ollama; wait up to 5s for VRAM capacity
      - OLLAMA_AGENT_MAX_CONCURRENT=1
      - OLLAMA_CAPACITY_WAIT=5
      # Retry Ollama on runner crash/OOM: 3 attempts, 5s delay (then 503)
      - OLLAMA_RETRY_ATTEMPTS=3
      - OLLAMA_RETRY_DELAY=5
      # VRAM gate: don't forward if Ollama already uses this many bytes (6 GiB). Set to empty to disable.

      # Smaller model for the tool loop (from /api/tags). Use the most suited of what we have, e.g. llama3.2:1b.
      - OLLAMA_TOOL_MODEL=llama3.2:1b

#!/bin/bash
set -e

# --- Configuration ---
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=$(nproc)
export MODELS_DIR="/models"

# --- Model Selection ---
echo "## Looking for GGUF models in ${MODELS_DIR}..."
GGUF_FILE=$(find "${MODELS_DIR}" -name "*.gguf" -type f 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -1)

if [[ -z "${GGUF_FILE}" ]]; then
    echo "## No GGUF model found in ${MODELS_DIR}"
    echo "## Available model files:"
    find "${MODELS_DIR}" -name "*.gguf" -type f 2>/dev/null || echo "## Models directory exists but is empty (no .gguf files)"
    echo ""
    echo "## To download a model, run one of the following:"
    echo "##   cd ${MODELS_DIR} && wget https://huggingface.co/mradermacher/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-i1-GGUF/resolve/main/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf"
    echo "## Or use the quantize.sh script to set up Git LFS cloning"
    echo ""
    echo "## Exit code 1: No model available"
    exit 1
fi

# --- Start Server ---
echo "## Starting Llama Server with: ${GGUF_FILE}"

# Check if the GGUF file exists and is valid
